en: Colorized vintage view over a hilly town with dense greenery. In the foreground there is a winding white path through a park or landscaped hillside, with trees and flowerbeds along fences. Below the hill stands a cluster of small houses and industrial buildings with red and light-colored roofs and a tall brick smokestack. On the ridge above are larger bourgeois-style houses and mansions, and on the right a prominent Gothic-style church with a tall spire. Beyond, a river plain or lowlands stretch into the distance. The card shows heavy age stains and discoloration, especially in the sky area. No legible printed text is visible on the image side.
